name: network.mintex.module_kyc.ui.activity.CaptureDocumentBackResultActivity
description: After the user photographs the back of an ID card or driver license, the Verifybloc KYC SDK shows the image here for a readability check. The user can accept it or retake it.
disableEffect: The user cannot review and confirm the back of the identity document, which can stop the KYC application.
